reason: The README documents a dsh media plugin for image and video generation plus image recognition through configurable grok2api or LLM provider APIs, with optional workspace saving.

summaries.zh: 通过可配置的 grok2api 或 LLM 提供商为 dsh 提供图片生成、视频生成和图片识别工具，并可选择将生成媒体保存到会话工作区。
summaries.en: Provides dsh with configurable image generation, video generation, and image recognition tools through grok2api or an LLM provider, with optional saving of generated media to the session workspace.

capabilities: Calls configured grok2api or LLM provider APIs
Sends local or remote images for recognition
Downloads generated media to the session workspace when enabled
